_about: The shared contract between the story writer, the validator and the renderer. Positions (x) are 0-100 percent across the stage, left to right.

bedroom.about: dark bedroom: bed, nightstand with a red digital clock, window, door

desk.about: room with a desk, chair, laptop and a warm desk lamp; window behind

kitchen.about: dark kitchen with a fridge that throws light when open, counter

street.about: night street: shopfronts (CAFE, LAUNDRY), lit windows, streetlights

park.about: park at night: wooden bench under a lamp post, trees, fence

cafe.about: cafe interior: counter, menu board, pendant lamp, barista behind counter

gym.about: dark gym with a spotlight, squat rack, dumbbells

hill.about: a long slope rising left to right over a distant city, good for climbing / running metaphors

rooftop.about: rooftop ledge over a city skyline; sky changes with time of day

hallway.about: dark hallway with a door; light spills when it opens

void.about: black emptiness with a single spotlight; inner thoughts, title cards

bus_stop.about: bus shelter on a city street with a bench and a lit roof; great in rain

office.about: open office: cubicles, monitors, fluorescent lights; desk in the foreground like 'desk'

classroom.about: classroom: chalkboard, rows of desks in the foreground, window

living_room.about: living room: sofa, floor lamp, TV glow, family photos on the wall

train.about: inside a train or subway car at night, the city streaming past the windows
train.seat: bench seats along the whole car

beach.about: beach and sea; sun on the horizon at dusk or dawn

stage.about: theatre stage: red curtains, a spotlight, audience silhouettes in front

hospital.about: hospital room: bed with rails, heart monitor, a visitor chair, window

poses.sit: sits on the set's seat at x; with facing -1 or 1 the character sits side-on (use at tables, facing each other)
poses.phone: looks at a phone held in front of the chest (stand or sit with 'seated': true)
poses.type: sits typing / drawing at the desk
poses.lean: leans toward the target actor, looming (best for the demon)
poses.grab: puts a hand on the target actor's shoulder (best for the demon)
poses.hugknees: sits on the floor hugging knees
poses.call: holds a phone to the ear
poses.reachout: reaches a hand toward the target actor
poses.knock: knocks on a door in the 'facing' direction
poses.hug: hugs the target actor (put them about 8 apart)
poses.umbrella: holds an umbrella overhead (can walk with x/to)

kinds.friend: a friendly character (hat colour sets them apart)
kinds.demon: the black inner voice with a red glow; says cruel lines in red

frames.close: subject's head and shoulders, background blurred
frames.phone: point-of-view phone screen held in hands (needs 'phone')
frames.insert: close-up of an object (needs 'insert'): a note being written, a calendar being marked, a photo, a letter

phone_apps.chat: messages appear; optional typing that can be deleted or sent
phone_apps.call: incoming call screen; can be declined or answered
phone_apps.lock: lock screen with time and notifications
phone_apps.feed: social feed scrolling past other people having fun
phone_apps.off: lock screen, then the thumb presses the side button and the screen goes black (off_at seconds)

inserts.note: {type:'note', text:'look up sometimes :)'} handwriting appears on a notebook page
inserts.calendar: {type:'calendar', month:'NOV', days:30, from:1, marked:14, mark:'check'|'x'} days get marked
inserts.photo: {type:'photo', who:['hero','mia'], text:'saturday'} a polaroid of characters

line_styles.float: plain white text above the head
line_styles.narrator: who:'narrator' -> spoken by the voiceover and shown at the bottom; optional 'twist' second line in bold

cards.line: one narration line typed on black (great cold open)
cards.quote: two lines, the second bold (the twist)
cards.red: imperative in the theme colour, e.g. LOOK UP. / Right now.
cards.logo: the film's title card, e.g. 'LUST vs LOVE.' + 1-2 tagline lines
cards.title: plain title

big: {text:'DAY 1.', at:0.3} huge words in the scene
hud: optional on-screen counters: film.hud = {items:[{label:'SEEN', color:'#ff4fa0'}, {label:'KNOWN', color:'#ffd34a'}]}; per shot hud = {values:[1003, 0], chapter:'DAY 1', alert:true}. Use a counter only when the story is about a measurable thing; a chapter alone ('DAY 4') also works; or no hud at all.

wardrobe.top: colour name: grey, charcoal, green, olive, navy, blue, red, maroon, yellow, mustard, orange, brown, beige, white, black, pink, purple, teal
